name: CPU Volume Raycasting
definition: A fully CPU-based direct volume rendering technique that uses volume raycasting with multithreaded pixel processing, supporting RGB+transparency transfer functions and Phong lighting (ambient + diffuse), without pixel interpolation or gradient smoothing.
summary: CPU Volume Raycasting is a direct volume rendering technique that uses explicit multithreaded pixel processing on the CPU, trilinear interpolation, and early ray termination to compute the volume rendering integral.
